entries.title: Psalms 55:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments: an instruction. Of David.>> Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

entries.title: Psalms 55:2
segments: Attend unto me, and answer me: I wander about in my plaint, and I moan aloud,

entries.title: Psalms 55:3
segments: Because of the voice of the enemy; because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in anger they persecute me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:4
segments: My heart is writhing within me, and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:5
segments: Fear and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:6
segments: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away, and be at rest;

entries.title: Psalms 55:7
segments: Behold, I would flee afar off, I would lodge in the wilderness; Selah;

entries.title: Psalms 55:8
segments: I would hasten my escape from the stormy wind, from the tempest.

entries.title: Psalms 55:9
segments: ¶Swallow [them] up, Lord; divide their tongue: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

entries.title: Psalms 55:10
segments: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof; and iniquity and mischief are in the midst of it.

entries.title: Psalms 55:11
segments: Perversities are in the midst thereof; and oppression and deceit depart not from its streets.

entries.title: Psalms 55:12
segments: For it is not an enemy that hath reproached me--then could I have borne it; neither is it he that hateth me that hath magnified [himself] against me--then would I have hidden myself from him;

entries.title: Psalms 55:13
segments: But it was thou, a man mine equal, mine intimate, my familiar friend. ...

entries.title: Psalms 55:14
segments: We who held sweet intercourse together. To the house of God we walked amid the throng.

entries.title: Psalms 55:15
segments: Let death seize upon them, let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is in their dwellings, in their midst.

entries.title: Psalms 55:16
segments: ¶As for me, unto God will I call; and Jehovah will save me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:17
segments: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray and moan aloud; and he will hear my voice.

entries.title: Psalms 55:18
segments: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle against me: for there were many about me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:19
segments: *God will hear, and afflict them: he that is seated of old, (Selah) ...because there is no change in them, and they fear not God.

entries.title: Psalms 55:20
segments: He hath put forth his hands against such as are at peace with him; he hath profaned his covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 55:21
segments: Smooth were the milky [words] of his mouth, but his heart was war; his words were softer than oil, yet are they drawn swords.

entries.title: Psalms 55:22
segments: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and *he* will sustain thee: he will never suffer the righteous to be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 55:23
segments: And thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days. But as for me, I will confide in thee.
